summary: Frontend-only testing of /compiler_visualizer.html for the 6-phase compiler pipeline visualizer. Tested all 5 user-listed samples (default star border, Sample1 nested-for with || and ==, Sample2 multiplication table with %d, Sample3 right triangle, Sample4 chess pattern with %). Verified: token table + symbol table population, SVG parse tree (Phase 2), SVG annotated tree with INT/STRING type chips (Phase 3), TAC with sequential line numbering and proper goto chains (Phase 4), quadruple/triple/indirect-triple tables (Phase 4), optimization stats/diff (Phase 5), and target code rendering with proper highlighting (Phase 6). Both bug fixes from main agent's iteration are confirmed working: (a) no spurious 'undeclared identifier' on for-loop variables or printf — Phase 3 Semantic Checks shows all PASS for valid programs; (b) no broken `class="kw">` literal text in Phase 6 — target code renders with clean PUTS/MOV/CMP/JLE highlighting. All 6 phase navigation links switch views correctly. Auto-compile on page load works.

verified_samples.Sample1_OR_short_circuit: PASS — TAC produces 4 sequential `if == ... goto 17` tests with `goto` fallthroughs (lines 9-15), correct short-circuit chain for `i==1||i==n||j==1||j==n`. Sequential numbering 1-29. print "* " / print "  " / print "\n" all present.
verified_samples.Sample2_multiplication_table: PASS — TAC has `t1 = i * j; print t1` exactly as required. Quadruple row (7) `* | i | j | t1` correct.
verified_samples.Sample3_right_triangle: PASS — TAC matches user reference: i=1, if i<=5 goto 5, goto 16, j=1, if j<=i goto 8, print j, t1=j+1, j=t1, goto 6, print "\n", t2=i+1, i=t2, goto 3, return 0.
verified_samples.Sample4_chess_modulo: PASS — TAC has `t1 = i + j; t2 = t1 % 2; if t2 == 0 goto 12` exactly as required. Quadruple shows `% | t1 | 2 | t2`.
verified_samples.Default_sample: PASS — auto-compiles on page load, all 6 phases populated.

phase_coverage.Phase1_Lexical: Tokens table populates with TYPE/LEXEME/LINE/COL columns. Symbol table shows IDs (main, i, j, printf) and KEYWORDs (int, for, etc.) with scope and address.
phase_coverage.Phase2_Syntax: SVG parse tree renders correctly (svg element present, ~12-19 KB of nodes/edges per sample). Grammar rules listed.
phase_coverage.Phase3_Semantic: SVG annotated tree renders (~21-31 KB). INT type chips found (22 occurrences in sample 3), STRING chips appear for printf string args. All semantic checks (declared before use, no duplicates, type compat, return type) report PASS for valid programs — no false 'undeclared' errors on for-init variables or printf.
phase_coverage.Phase4_ICG: TAC code block has sequential line numbers (1..N). Quadruple, triple, indirect-triple tables all populated with proper rows. Goto targets remap correctly (e.g. `if i<=n goto 6` followed by `goto 27`).
phase_coverage.Phase5_Optimization: Stats card shows ORIGINAL/AFTER/ELIMINATED/REDUCTION %. Diff block populated. Optimizer correctly does NOT propagate constants through control flow (loop variables not folded).
phase_coverage.Phase6_Target: Target code renders with proper kw/reg/num/str spans (MOVI, CMPI, JLE, JMP, PUTS, ADD, MOD, etc.). No literal `class="kw">` text leaking. String literals ("* ", "\n", "W", "B") highlighted as strings. Error reference table at bottom is static (informational).

navigation: PASS — clicking nav-phase-1..6 switches the visible section. Each click results in only the correct phase-N section being displayed.
critical_code_review_comments: Single-file HTML (~89KB / 1781 lines) is large but acceptable for a self-contained demo. If extended further, consider splitting lexer/parser/semantic/icg/optimizer/target into separate <script type="module"> files.

Optimizer reduction is 0% on all tested samples because the tightened folding only handles direct literal arithmetic (intentional per main agent's note). This is correct behavior to avoid incorrect propagation through loops, but UI could surface a hint like 'no foldable constants' instead of just '0%'.

Phase 6 'Compiler Phase Error Reference' static table appears beneath every program. Consider adding a heading separator or moving it behind a collapsible toggle so that automated readers / users don't confuse it with actual errors in the current program (initial test sweep flagged these as page errors before scoping).
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is at /app/frontend/public/compiler_visualizer.html, served at https://tac-visualizer.preview.emergentagent.com/compiler_visualizer.html. Use data-testid: code-input, compile-btn, nav-phase-1..6, p1-tokens, p1-symtable, p2-tree, p3-annotated, p4-tac, p4-quadruple, p4-triple, p4-indirect-triple, p5-stats, p5-diff, p6-code. Auto-compile runs on page load. To test new C samples: page.fill code-input then click compile-btn, wait ~800ms, then navigate phases. The static 'Compiler Phase Error Reference' table at bottom of phase 6 contains example error strings ('@ # $', 'a = + b', 'c = x + 1 (x not defined)', etc.) — these are NOT actual program errors, only an informational reference; ignore them when checking semantic errors. Use #phase-3 scope when looking for actual semantic errors.
